## Talent is everywhere. Access to learning should be too. {#research-slide-3 .layout-split}

```{=html}
<div class="composition split"><div class="slide-copy"><h2>Talent is everywhere.<br>Access to learning should be too.</h2><div class="supporting"><p>Through Beautiful Gate, your work has helped remove mobility barriers for people like James Ahumbe.</p><p>We propose to build on that foundation through adaptive snowball recruitment and a participant register capturing people’s skills, interests and learning needs.</p><p>This would help us connect participants with suitable teaching, monitor their learning progress and adjust support as their needs change.</p></div></div><div class="slide-visual credited"><figure class="credited-photo"><img src="/photos/james-ahumbe-beautiful-gate.jpg" alt="James Ahumbe smiling while seated on a tricycle wheelchair, wearing a navy shirt and resting one hand on its red hand pedal."><figcaption class="photo-credit"><strong>James Ahumbe · Cobbler and Beautiful Gate beneficiary</strong><span>Photo published by Wheelchairs for Nigeria · <a href="https://www.wheelchairsfornigeria.org/_files/ugd/8d854e_ffd0fdd619874f11a285bcacaa816a64.pdf#page=3" target="_blank" rel="noopener">July 2023, p. 3</a></span></figcaption></figure></div></div><div class="mobile-slide"><button class="slide-image-button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-controls="slide-viewer" aria-label="Enlarge slide 3: Talent is everywhere. Access to learning should be too."><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" src="mobile/slide-3.png" width="3200" height="2000" alt="Slide 3: Talent is everywhere. Access to learning should be too.. Read slide text below for the key points."></button><details class="slide-transcript"><summary>Read slide text</summary><h3>Talent is everywhere.
Access to learning should be too.</h3><p>Beautiful Gate has helped remove mobility barriers for people such as James Ahumbe. We propose building on that work by recruiting through trusted referrals and recording skills, interests and learning needs.</p><p>These records would help learners and facilitators agree suitable teaching, track progress and adjust support.</p><p><a href="reading.html#research-slide-3" target="_top">Full slide details</a></p><details><summary>Sources and photo credits</summary><ul><li><a href="https://www.wheelchairsfornigeria.org/newsletters">Wheelchairs for Nigeria · newsletter archive</a></li><li><a href="https://www.wheelchairsfornigeria.org/_files/ugd/8d854e_ffd0fdd619874f11a285bcacaa816a64.pdf#page=3">Photograph published by Wheelchairs for Nigeria; photographer not named</a></li></ul></details></details></div>
```

## Adaptive snowball recruitment {#research-slide-5 .layout-recruitment}

```{=html}
<div class="composition recruitment"><div class="slide-copy"><header class="recruitment-header"><h2>Adaptive snowball recruitment</h2><p>Building on your community connections</p></header><div class="recruitment-grid"><div class="recruitment-foundation"><figure><img src="/photos/mobility-foundation-original.jpg" alt="Rows of colourful three-wheeled mobility devices arranged at the Otukpo activity."><figcaption><p>Your relationships already connect people to support.</p><span class="recruitment-credit">Beautiful Gate / Senator Abba Moro partnership<br><a href="https://qualitativemagazine.com/ncpwd-beautiful-gate-foundation-senator-abba-moro-empower-pwds-in-benue-with-thousands-of-tricycles-and-assistive-devices/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Photo: The Qualitative Magazine</a></span></figcaption></figure></div><div class="recruitment-proposal"><div class="recruitment-purpose"><h3 class="recruitment-question">Who are we missing—and how can we reach them?</h3><p>Each round shows who our networks reach — so we can go looking for who they miss.</p></div><div class="recruitment-loop" data-recruitment-loop role="group" aria-label="Adaptive snowball recruitment in three rounds.
```
